name: Upwork AI Job Screening & Slack Alerts

values.content:
=You're screening Upwork job posts for a freelancer who specifically does n8n workflow automation, Zapier/Make.com scenarios, CRM integrations (Attio, HubSpot, GoHighLevel backend work), Voice AI, and backend/API integration development.

Job title: {{ $json.title }}
Job description: {{ $json.content }}

Mark relevant ONLY if this is a genuine fit for someone who builds automation workflows/backend integrations as their core skill, such as:
- Building or fixing n8n, Zapier, or Make.com workflows
- CRM/API integration development (connecting systems together via code/no-code tools)
- Voice AI or chatbot backend development
- Custom automation scripting or backend developer roles

Mark NOT relevant if the job is:
- Generic admin/virtual assistant work (data entry, spreadsheet cleanup, lead list building) even if it mentions 'automation' loosely
- Marketing, copywriting, content, video editing, or design work
- Sales/closing roles (e.g. 'SaaS closer', 'high-ticket closer') even if automation-adjacent
- Excel/spreadsheet formula work that isn't actual workflow automation
- Too vague to tell if real automation development is required

Reply with ONLY valid JSON, no other text:
{"relevant": true or false, "reason": "one short sentence why"}
